## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is leading on the week but mixed internally: NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION. Sector showing rotation within mega-caps; breadth concentrated in fewer names (24 stocks total, mixed internals).

**8. Financials Outlook?**

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed to weak: LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND — defensive names uneven and GLP-1 coverage headlines weighing on select names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Financials and proven Tech leaders (JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to lagging Consumer Discretionary and some Energy names (NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given concentrated top-end gains.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND — sustain weekly momentum to confirm continuation. AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY — hold of 1W gains would validate reversal. JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND — breakout above recent 1M range would signal broader Financials follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND are key laggards.
